snippet.title: Holder of Place | Announcement Trailer | Atmospheric Autobattler | Demo Available Now
snippet.description:
Play the demo and wishlist the game on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464970/Holder_of_Place/

Recruit followers to fight for you, arrange them for optimal synergies and watch the battle unfold. Along the way, you will experience a dark science-fantasy tale of a ruined kingdom, meet strange characters, visit exotic locations and discover powerful relics.
